recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.description: Enter your account's email. Elysium makes a one-time link that signs you in so you can choose a new password.
recovery.loadError: The recovery form could not load. Refresh the page to try again.

sent.description: If that address has an account, a recovery link was made. Elysium can't send email yet, so the link is in the server's log: ask an admin to pass it on. It works once, for 15 minutes.

pending.heading: Waiting for approval
pending.description: Thanks for signing up, {{name}}. An admin needs to approve your account before you can use the workspace.
pending.automatic: This page opens the workspace on its own once you're approved.

error.heading: Something went wrong
error.description: That link or form is no longer valid.

security.title: Sign-in & security
security.loadError: Your security settings could not load.
security.expired: The page was open too long, so it reloaded. Make your change again.

enrollment.description: This workspace requires two-factor authentication. Choose Add 2FA below to continue.

twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.switchHeading: Move to a new authenticator app
